the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: two sections of U'/R' mapping equal in U/R become pairs a_i, a_i' over a tau-covering; the pointwise description of quotient sheaves (045Y) refines the covering so that a relation r_i in R between g a_i and g a_i' exists; since R' is the fibre product of R with U' x U' over U x U, the pair (r_i, (a_i, a_i')) is a section of R' witnessing the equivalence, so xi = xi' by the sheaf condition; surjectivity holds when g induces a sheaf surjection, in particular when g is a covering (00WT) (source lines 4052-4075)
